raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview
Until now the `:intel: (BMG) Batch Invariance` job only ran the XPU unit tests and the online PowerMoE script, so regressions in `test_batch_invariance.py` on XPU were not caught.

This adds to the existing job:
- `v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py` (single card, TRITON_ATTN)
- `test_batch_invariance.py -k "bs1_vs_bsN or without_batch_invariance_should_fail"` with TP=2
  (covers the fixed-rank-order XCCL reduction from #55881)

and widens `source_file_dependencies` to `tests/v1/determinism/`.

`test_matmul_batch_invariant.py` also passes on XPU but is left out for now since it is on the test-tethering allowlist; it will be added in a follow-up.

## Test Plan
Ran the job's command on 8x Arc Pro B60

## Test Results

| Command | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| test_xpu_batch_invariant_ut.py | 28 passed | 23s |
| test_batch_invariance.py | 7 passed, 2 skipped (CUDA-only) | 648s |
| TP=2 bs1_vs_bsN / without_batch_invariance_should_fail | 3 passed, 1 skipped | 293s |
| run-xpu-batch-invariance.sh | passed | 190s |

Sequential total ≈ 20 min, within the job's 60 min timeout.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [ ] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [ ] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

detail.title: [CI][XPU] Extend batch-invariance tests in Intel CI

files.patch:
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ depends_on:
 steps:
 - label: ":intel: (BMG) Batch Invariance"
   key: xpu-batch-invariance
-  timeout_in_minutes: 60
+  timeout_in_minutes: 70
   num_devices: 2
   device: intel_gpu
   agent_tags:
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@ steps:
     VLLM_TEST_DEVICE: "xpu"
   source_file_dependencies:
     - vllm/
-    - tests/v1/determinism/test_xpu_batch_invariant_ut.py
+    - tests/v1/determinism/
     - .buildkite/scripts/hardware_ci/run-xpu-batch-invariance.sh
     - .buildkite/intel_jobs/misc_intel.yaml
   commands:
@@ -28,6 +28,9 @@ steps:
       'export VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 &&
       cd tests &&
       pytest -v -s v1/determinism/test_xpu_batch_invariant_ut.py &&
+      pytest -v -s v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py &&
+      VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=2 pytest -v -s v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py
+      -k "bs1_vs_bsN or without_batch_invariance_should_fail" &&
       bash ../.buildkite/scripts/hardware_ci/run-xpu-batch-invariance.sh'
 
 # Disabled until the KV connectors installation is locked.
